candidats.titre: File:Engineer Corps, Road Building (1918-1919) - DPLA - f672a471641c8fc85119d020ec524d82 (page 6).jpg
candidats.description: This film contains the following: in reel 1, 532nd Engineers blast rock at Neufchateau, France. The 28th Engineers operate rock-crushing machinery. Wounded arrive by train at Aulnois. Prisoners load trucks with crushed rock. The 23rd Engineers repair railroad track at Mandres. It also shows gas tractors and steam rollers at work. Rock is crushed and the Tours-Dijon road is repaired. In reel 2, 108th Engineers repair a road near Brabant. The 101st Engineers fill shell holes with logs and rock. The 28th Engineers quarry stone at Haucourt. The 23rd, 103rd., 108th, and 111th Engineers repair roads
